summary.zh: 分子证据支持把杉科并入柏科，水杉、柳杉、柏木等同属一家。
summary.en: Molecular evidence supports merging Taxodiaceae into Cupressaceae: dawn redwood, cryptomeria and cypresses all belong here.

debate.zh: 传统分类把杉科独立，现行系统多数并入柏科。
debate.en: Older classifications kept Taxodiaceae separate; most current systems merge it.
